messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 17):
"""
YES/NO 3.6.1 If yes, Refund payable on cancellation by the Insured Time of Cancellation Policy Duration (specify for each tenure of policy) One Year Two Year Three Year etc. 3.6.2 Whether cancellation by the insurer allowed on grounds of established fraud/mis-representation/ non-disclosure of material facts YES/NO 3.6.3 If yes, Refunds, if any, payable on cancellation by the Insurer Time of Cancellation Policy Duration (specify for each tenure of policy) One Year Two Year Three Year etc. 3.7 Specify Non-forfeiture conditions [When the contract would be not null and void] 3.8 Specify options available under the product. (e.g. to increase or decrease benefits, plan changes, etc.) [This section should specify the various options available under the product.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If I cancel my health insurance policy after two years, how much refund will I receive from the insurer?","answer":"The refund payable on cancellation by the insured after two years is specified in the policy duration section of the form.","facts":["Time of Cancellation Policy Duration (specify for each tenure of policy)","One Year","Two Year"]},{"question":"Can the insurer cancel my policy for fraud or misrepresentation, and will I get any refund?","answer":"Yes, the insurer may cancel the policy on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, or non-disclosure of material facts, and any refund payable is specified in the policy duration section.","facts":["Whether cancellation by the insurer allowed on grounds of established fraud/mis-representation/ non-disclosure of material facts","YES/NO","Refunds, if any, payable on cancellation by the Insurer Time of Cancellation Policy Duration"]}]}
